text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, a meteor shower is visible 
tonight. As I gazed up at the sky—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A light raced across the night sky.
choice_data_list: I want to make <nickname> even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chanting a wish three times toward the 
stars like a magic spell. Whether that 
prayer was heard or not...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A shooting star blinked across the sky 
several times.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that day on, <chrname>'s running became 
visibly sharper!
